summary: The Form 6-K filed by Pearson plc on May 20, 2026 reports a PDMR transaction: President of Higher Education & Virtual Learning Tom ap Simon purchased 2,621.78 ADRs at $15.1965 each ($39,841.88 total) under the company's Dividend Reinvestment Plan on May 18, 2026. This is a routine insider equity acquisition arising from a standing DRIP, not a special-situation event. No deal terms, board recommendation, or regulatory mechanics apply.
